<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the described cycloaddition transformation (formation of a C‑C bond, breaking of a C‑O bond, loss of a ketone and a C≡C bond). Using the criteria tool should return candidate templates, from which we can pick one, retrieve its SMARTS, and then apply it to the target molecule to obtain all possible precursor combinations.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O", "C≡C"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
